controlledModelCases.head: ff05d23dadc1fb1d9b4e28c3d974f37ab2110ff1
controlledModelCases.question: Does the revised display preserve the amount emitted by the producer?
controlledModelCases.requirements: The producer owns parsing incoming amount text and emits integer cents. The display consumes integer cents and displays the same amount with two decimal places. Changing the representation or interpreting input text in the consumer is outside this change. Review the revised display and its existing producer for correctness.

reviewer.head: ff05d23dadc1fb1d9b4e28c3d974f37ab2110ff1
reviewer.summary: The revised display divides integer cents by 100 twice, so it does not preserve the producer's amount.

findings.title: Remove the second division by 100
findings.consequence: The producer converts input text to integer cents. The display now divides those cents by 10,000 overall: input "123.45" produces 12345 cents but displays "1.23" instead of "123.45". Keep only one conversion from cents before formatting.
